capabilities: Publish a folder as a package with title, description, and tags
Browse, filter, and download community packages
Update downloaded packages in place while preserving untouched files
Run pre-publish checks for broken links and camera EXIF metadata
Sign in with GitHub to publish packages
extras: The free community service is operated by the plugin; the server rejects executable content (dataviewjs, Templater, script tags) at publish time and scans for GPS/serial EXIF data in JPGs before upload. The plugin listing is marked as not manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author felt that time spent organizing courses, notes, or guides could save others effort, and wanted to remove the friction of sharing and downloading interlinked notes between vaults.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to share interlinked note collections between vaults without manually copying files and fixing links.

relations.evidence: Alternatively, install through BRAT by pointing it at this repository.

summary: Publishes vault folders as shareable note packages and lets users browse, download, install, and update packages shared by the community.
